scope: StateStore construction against an existing unknown SQLite file
failure_before: A non-empty SQLite file with user tables but without schema_migrations could be opened and receive V4 DDL implicitly, creating a mixed legacy/V4 authority.
red_observed: Before the fix StateStore opened the legacy_state database and the test observed no EXPLICIT_MIGRATION_REQUIRED error.
implementation: StateStore performs a read-only sqlite_master check before migration; missing/empty files remain new stores, marked V4 schemas continue through normal migrations, and unknown existing user tables fail with EXPLICIT_MIGRATION_REQUIRED without writing the source.
full_regression: V4 core 193/193 PASS; GUI bridge 498/498 PASS
acceptance: This proves the fail-closed guard only. It does not migrate or authorize any production database; explicit migration remains a separate reviewed operation.
